text:
rachel: Quick heads-up  deploying vectorizer-v1. Feature flag vectorizer-v1-ff will be toggled in us-east first. Change window 2h. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-vectorizer :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary cr-9001 created. t0 -> 1% traffic to v1 in us-east (az a). Dash: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-9001

tom: Rollout plan (holding points) I'm applying now:
```
feature_flag: vectorizer-v1-ff
rollout:
  - t0: 1%
  - t+12m: 5%  # hold 20m
  - t+45m: 25% # hold 30m
  - manual: 100%
triggers:
  p95_increase_ms: 120
  error_rate_pct: 0.3
  token_throughput_pct: 30
```

jing: Fallback ready: tag=v0-pin-2026-03-21. Rollback cmd staged: `/ff set vectorizer-v1-ff 0% && route-pin set default vector-router v0 --tag v0-pin-2026-03-21`

ops-bot: Monitoring token throughput & AZ mem. If an AZ shows sustained CPU/mem delta >20% we'll pin that AZ to v0 instead of full rollback.

deploy-bot: t+15m metrics: p50 +6ms, p95 +18ms, errors nominal. Advancing to 5% in us-east.

jing: Noticing tail latency in us-east-1b for the canary subset. Not at trigger yet but persistent for 8m. Recommend AZ override preemptively if it continues.

rachel: Okay apply AZ override to pin us-east-1b to v0 and exclude it from the ramp. Do not global ramp until 25m stable excluding that AZ.

deploy-bot: AZ override applied: us-east-1b pinned to v0 (command executed). Canary metrics excluding pinned AZ stable at 5%.

tom: After 25m stable we'll move to 25% (hold 30m). Keep manual approval for final 100%.

oncall: Synthetics running: core flows passing, smoke alerts none. I'll stand by for rollback page if needed.

rachel: Good. Proceed to 25% now. `/ff roll vectorizer-v1-ff --region us-east --target 25 --hold 30m`

deploy-bot: Flag updated to 25% in us-east. Monitor: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-9001/metrics

jing: AZ pin removed after compaction job finished; traffic balanced. No rollback triggers.

oncall: Business KPIs unchanged. Green.

rachel: Manual approval to go to 100% granted. Final step in 5m if stable. No other deploys to routing infra during window.

deploy-bot: Rolled vectorizer-v1-ff to 100% in us-east. Canary cr-9001 closed (success). Global rollout scheduled to eu/apac in 1h with same holds. Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-vectorizer#done :tada:
